signal: July generated eight leads: one Google form lead and seven Meta form leads. The new Higher Intent Meta form is in place to improve lead quality while Google continues building Philadelphia visibility and site traffic.
goal: Connect July leads to bridal appointments, improve the quality of incoming inquiries, and keep the strongest Philadelphia search and Meta traffic moving toward booked consultations.
work: Mapped the appointment journey from ad click to form submission and booked consultation so August reporting can focus on the inquiries most likely to become appointments.

platforms.name: Google Ads
platforms.note: Google delivered 35,258 impressions and 906 clicks on $570.89 across the two campaigns that spent, for a $0.63 blended CPC. Google also generated one form lead during July.

platforms.name: Meta Ads
platforms.note: Meta generated seven form leads at $7.37 per lead and 335 landing-page views at $0.46 each. The new Higher Intent form adds SMS verification and qualification questions to support stronger appointment quality in August.

outcome.platform: Eight platform-reported leads: 1 Google Submit lead form conversion event plus 7 native Meta form leads. Meta also recorded 335 LPVs.
outcome.business: The August focus is connecting these eight leads to consultations so campaign decisions reflect appointment quality as well as lead volume.
outcome.measurement: Google conversion events count as leads in this report. August reporting will connect each form submission to the appointment record using source and timestamp.
